stem:
Two customers went to a post office to buy postcards and large envelopes. Each postcard costs the same amount, and each large envelope costs the same amount.

• The first customer paid $12 for 14 postcards and 5 large envelopes.
• The second customer paid $24.80 for 10 postcards and 15 large envelopes.

What was the cost in dollars of each large envelope?
visual_elements: Two customers went to a post office to buy postcards and large envelopes. Each postcard costs the same amount, and each large envelope costs the same amount. The first customer paid $12 for 14 postcards and 5 large envelopes. The second customer paid $24.80 for 10 postcards and 15 large envelopes. What was the cost in dollars of each large envelope? Options: A $1.42, B $0.35, C $1.15, D $0.63
